sourcedFrom: VOLQUARTSEN SCORPION PISTOL OWNER’S MANUAL — UNKNOWN — no revision code printed (UNKNOWN — not printed in the document)
cleanIntro: The Scorpion is a 1911-pattern rimfire pistol and it strips like one: the HAMMER comes down first, then the MAINSPRING is released with its own latch removal tool, then the barrel tips up, the bolt comes out, and the upper goes FORWARD off the frame. ⚠ It is the only one of Volquartsen's rimfire books that begins with a deliberate dry-fire, and the only one that puts a spring under tension in your hand. ⛔ The barrel rule is the same as every Volquartsen: breech to muzzle, pull-through only, or the warranty is gone.

steps.title: Clear it — no magazine, chamber empty
steps.action: Confirm the pistol is clear: no magazine inserted and the chamber clear. ⛔ This matters more here than on most strips, because the very next step is a deliberate trigger pull.
steps.prose: Read step two before you do step one and you will understand why the check has to be real.
steps.cite: VOLQUARTSEN SCORPION PISTOL OWNER’S MANUAL — UNKNOWN — no revision code printed — Disassembly, step 1, p.8

steps.title: ⛔ Safety OFF and DRY FIRE to drop the hammer — muzzle safe
steps.action: Disengage the safety and dry fire the trigger, releasing the hammer. ⛔ Muzzle in a safe direction, chamber proved empty a second time before your finger goes near the trigger. The mainspring cannot be released with the hammer cocked.
steps.prose: A strip that requires a trigger pull is a strip that requires the clearing check to be honest.
steps.quote:
Disengage the safety and dry fire
	
the trigger releasing the hammer.
steps.cite: VOLQUARTSEN SCORPION PISTOL OWNER’S MANUAL — UNKNOWN — no revision code printed — Disassembly, step 2, p.9

steps.title: ⚠ MAINSPRING under tension — use the latch removal tool
steps.action: Using the mainspring latch removal tool, pull BACK on the mainspring lever to release the mainspring. Then pivot the mainspring UP and pull DOWN on it to take it off the pistol. ⚠ It is a spring under load; keep hold of it and work over a tray.
steps.prose: The supplied tool exists because doing this with a screwdriver is how the mainspring ends up across the room.
steps.caution: Work over a tray. The mainspring is the one part on this pistol that will leave your hand.
steps.quote: Pivot the mainspring up and pull down on mainspring to remove from pistol.
steps.cite: VOLQUARTSEN SCORPION PISTOL OWNER’S MANUAL — UNKNOWN — no revision code printed — Disassembly, step 3, p.9

steps.title: Tilt the barrel UP and pull the bolt out
steps.action: Tilt the barrel of the gun upwards and pull the bolt out. The tilt is what gives the bolt its clearance — pulling it level fights the barrel.
steps.prose: Muzzle up, bolt back. Two seconds once you know it, a fight if you do not.
steps.quote: Press the upper forward off the frame (may need to use a soft hammer to tap the upper off the frame).
steps.cite: VOLQUARTSEN SCORPION PISTOL OWNER’S MANUAL — UNKNOWN — no revision code printed — Disassembly, step 5, p.9

steps.title: Upper FORWARD off the frame — a soft hammer is sanctioned
steps.action: Press the upper FORWARD off the frame. ⚠ Volquartsen says you may need a SOFT hammer to tap it off — that is the maker's own allowance, so a tight one is not a fault. Forward, never back.
steps.prose: Most 1911-pattern slides come back. This upper goes the other way, and that is the thing to remember.
steps.quote:
Press the upper forward off the
	
frame (may need to use a soft
	
hammer to tap the upper
	
off the frame).
steps.cite: VOLQUARTSEN SCORPION PISTOL OWNER’S MANUAL — UNKNOWN — no revision code printed — Disassembly, step 6, p.9

steps.title: ⛔ BREECH TO MUZZLE, PULL-THROUGH — bolt locked open
steps.action: Lock the bolt open with the bolt hold open feature and clean the barrel ONLY from breech to muzzle with a pull-through system. ⛔ A cleaning rod from the muzzle end voids the warranty and greatly affects accuracy.
steps.prose: Same rule, same reason, same crown. Volquartsen prints it on every book it publishes.
steps.quote:
The barrel should be cleaned only from breech to muzzle 
using a pull-through cleaning system. Lock the bolt open 
using the bolt hold open feature.
steps.cite: VOLQUARTSEN SCORPION PISTOL OWNER’S MANUAL — UNKNOWN — no revision code printed — Barrel Cleaning, p.13
steps.warn:
Any use of a cleaning rod 
from the muzzle end will void the warranty and greatly 
affect accuracy.

steps.title: Every 500-600 rounds, chamber more often, cotton swab only
steps.action: Thorough barrel cleaning approximately every 500 to 600 rounds. ⚠ The chamber may want doing more often, and only with a cotton swab.
steps.prose: Rimfire wax collects in the chamber first. A swab is enough and a brush is not sanctioned here.
steps.quote:
It may be necessary to clean the chamber on a 
more frequent basis using only a cotton swab.
steps.cite: VOLQUARTSEN SCORPION PISTOL OWNER’S MANUAL — UNKNOWN — no revision code printed — Barrel Cleaning, p.13

steps.title: ⚠ Ammunition — 22 LR, and NOT CCI Stinger
steps.action: Confirm the ammunition before loading. The Scorpion is designed for 22 Long Rifle. ⛔ CCI Stinger is not recommended in it because the cartridge is oversized, and Volquartsen states that incorrect ammunition can cause a bore obstruction and voids the warranty.
steps.prose: An oversized case in a tight match chamber is a bore obstruction waiting for the next round.
steps.quote: CCI® Stinger ammo is not recommended for use in this Volquartsen Scorpion Pistol due to the oversized cartridge.
steps.cite: VOLQUARTSEN SCORPION PISTOL OWNER’S MANUAL — UNKNOWN — no revision code printed — Ammunition, p.14

deepAbsentReason: Volquartsen's Scorpion Pistol manual publishes a six-step field strip and stops there. Beyond the mainspring, the bolt and the upper it documents no further disassembly — no extractor or firing-pin work, no trigger or sear procedure, no barrel removal — and it points the owner to its own video page rather than printing more. This listing therefore has NO deep clean, and nothing deeper is written for it.

cleaning.name: BARREL — THE RULE THAT VOIDS THE WARRANTY
tasks: Bolt locked open with the bolt hold open feature
⛔ Breech to muzzle ONLY, pull-through system
⛔ Never a cleaning rod from the muzzle end
Chamber more often, cotton swab only

cleaning.name: BOLT, UPPER AND FRAME
tasks: Upper rails and the frame's mating surfaces wiped
Mainspring and its latch inspected before they go back

reassembly: Upper back onto the frame from the front — soft hammer only if needed.
Barrel tilted up, bolt back in.
Mainspring pivoted into place and latched with its removal tool.
Hammer function and safety checked on an empty chamber, muzzle safe.
Ammunition confirmed 22 LR — ⛔ not CCI Stinger.
fncheck: Magazine out, chamber checked by eye. Confirm the mainspring is fully latched — that is the part this strip puts under tension and the one that must be seated before anything else is trusted. Cycle the bolt through full travel and confirm it locks open. Engage and disengage the safety, and dry-fire once with the muzzle safe to confirm the hammer falls and resets. ⚠ Then confirm the ammunition: 22 LR, ⛔ not CCI Stinger.
